name: treatment
title: Treatment
description: A dwc:Treatment applied to a data field to restrict access to compenents of the data that may be sensitive according to a dcterms:Agent.

fields.name: treatmentID
fields.title: Treatment ID
fields.comments: Recommended best practice is to use a globally unique identifier.

fields.name: treatmentField
fields.title: Treatment Field
fields.description: The specific data field that has been altered to protect sensitive information.

fields.name: verbatimTreatmentReason
fields.title: Verbatim Treatment Reason
fields.description: A string representing the reason for the application of a dwc:Treatment as it appeared in the original record.
fields.comments: This term is meant to allow the capture of an unaltered original name for a dwc:treatmentReason. This term is meant to be used in addition to dwc:treatmentReason, not instead of it.

fields.name: treatmentReason
fields.title: Treatment Reason
fields.description: A category that best matches the reason for the dwc:Treatment.
fields.comments: Recommended best practice is to use controlled value strings from the controlled vocabulary designated for use with this term, listed at <http://rs.gbif.org/vocabulary/dwc/rasd/reason/rasdReason>. This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

fields.name: treatmentReasonIRI
fields.title: Treatment Type (IRI)
fields.description: An IRI of a controlled vocabulary value for the reason for the dwc:Treatment.
fields.comments: Recommended best practice is to use controlled value strings from the controlled vocabulary designated for use with this term, listed at <http://rs.gbif.org/vocabulary/dwc/rasd/reason/rasdReason>.

fields.name: treatmentReasonSource
fields.title: Treatment Reason Source
fields.description: A reference to the controlled vocabulary in which the definition of a value in dwc:treatmentReason is given.
fields.rdfs:comment: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.

fields.name: treatmentType
fields.title: Treatment Type
fields.description: A category that best matches the nature of a dwc:Treatment.
fields.comments: Recommended best practice is to use controlled value strings from the controlled vocabulary designated for use with this term, listed at <http://rs.gbif.org/vocabulary/dwc/rasd/reason/rasdTreatment>. This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

fields.name: verbatimTreatmentType
fields.title: Verbatim Treatment Type
fields.description: A string representing the type of dwc:Treatment as it appeared in the original record.
fields.comments: This term is meant to allow the capture of an unaltered original name for a dwc:treatmentType. This term is meant to be used in addition to dwc:treatmentType, not instead of it.

fields.name: treatmentTypeIRI
fields.title: Treatment Type (IRI)
fields.description: An IRI of a controlled vocabulary value for a type of dwc:Treatment.
fields.comments: Recommended best practice is to use controlled value strings from the controlled vocabulary designated for use with this term, listed at <http://rs.gbif.org/vocabulary/dwc/rasd/reason/rasdTreatment>.

fields.name: treatmentTypeSource
fields.title: Treatment Type Source
fields.description: A reference to the controlled vocabulary in which the definition of a value in dwc:treatmentType is given.
fields.rdfs:comment: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.

fields.name: treatmentDescription
fields.title: Treatment Description
fields.description: Text description of the method applied to the data in making a dwc:Treatment.

fields.name: treatmentStartDate
fields.title: Treatment Start Date
fields.description: A date on which a dwc:Treatment was deemed to first be in effect.
fields.comments: Recommended best practice is to use a date that conforms to ISO 8601-1:2019.
fields.examples: `1963-03-08T14:07-06:00` (8 Mar 1963 at or after 2:07pm and before 2:08pm in the time zone six hours earlier than UTC); `2009-02-20T08:40Z` (20 February 2009 at or after 8:40am and before 8:41 UTC); `2018-08-29T15:19` (29 August 2018 at or after 3:19pm and before 3:20pm local time); `1809-02-12` (within the day 12 February 1809); `1906-06` (in the month of June 1906); `1971` (in the year 1971); `2007-03-01T13:00:00Z/2008-05-11T15:30:00Z` (some time within the interval beginning 1 March 2007 at 1pm UTC and before 11 May 2008 at 3:30pm UTC); `1900/1909` (some time within the interval between the beginning of the year 1900 and before the year 1909); `2007-11-13/15` (some time in the interval between the beginning of 13 November 2007 and before 15 November 2007)

fields.name: treatmentEndDate
fields.title: Treatment End Date
fields.description: A date on which a dwc:Treatment will cease/ceased to be in effect.
fields.comments: Recommended best practice is to use a date that conforms to ISO 8601-1:2019.
fields.examples: `1963-03-08T14:07-06:00` (8 Mar 1963 at or after 2:07pm and before 2:08pm in the time zone six hours earlier than UTC); `2009-02-20T08:40Z` (20 February 2009 at or after 8:40am and before 8:41 UTC); `2018-08-29T15:19` (29 August 2018 at or after 3:19pm and before 3:20pm local time); `1809-02-12` (within the day 12 February 1809); `1906-06` (in the month of June 1906); `1971` (in the year 1971); `2007-03-01T13:00:00Z/2008-05-11T15:30:00Z` (some time within the interval beginning 1 March 2007 at 1pm UTC and before 11 May 2008 at 3:30pm UTC); `1900/1909` (some time within the interval between the beginning of the year 1900 and before the year 1909); `2007-11-13/15` (some time in the interval between the beginning of 13 November 2007 and before 15 November 2007)

fields.name: treatmentOrganization
fields.title: Treatment Organization
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of names of dcterms:Agents responsible for making a dwc:Treatment.
fields.comments: Recommended best practice is to separate the values in a list with space vertical bar space (` | `).

fields.name: treatmentOrganizationID
fields.title: Treatment Organization ID
fields.description: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent responsible for making a dwc:Treatment.
fields.comments: Recommended best practice is to use a globally unique identifier.

fields.name: treatmentInEffect
fields.title: Treatment In Effect
fields.description: Boolean indicator for if the dwc:Treatment is the primary restriction currently in effect on the dwc:treatmentField.
fields.comments: Some restrictions override less severe restrictions, therefore rendering some current restrictions invisible.
